publisher: Virginia State Corporation Commission Office of the Clerk
reassessment_reason: Separate actual current document access from discretionary structured-data services; historical procurement descriptions do not specify the current extract.

access.bulk: 5VAC5-40-10(D) allows reasonable charges for database records and discretionary creation of an abstract or summary. No recurring business-entity bulk product was verified.
access.api: Public CIS is an interactive filing/search service; no supported public bulk API contract was established.
access.fees: Structured-data price unknown. The separate $6 certificate/certified-copy service does not price a database extract.

fields.summary: Current corporate forms distinguish principal office from registered office and identify officers/directors. No current bulk schema, identifier lifecycle or person-free projection was established.

active_status_semantics: Good-standing certificates and annual-report filing requirements establish administrative facts, not current physical operation. A complete extract status dictionary remains required.
statewide_completeness: The Clerk holds corporate and related filing records; the reviewed sources do not establish a current full extract population or all operating businesses; statewide_complete=false.
address_zip: Principal office and registered office are distinct roles; neither proves an operating establishment. ZIP5 and ZIP4 remain separate fields.
automation_terms_fees: Public examination and electronic document access do not establish a recurring automated extract. The web policy prohibits unintended system use; supported bulk transport remains unresolved.
redistribution: Website policy grants fair use, encourages attribution and restricts commercial use beyond intended public availability. Product-specific derived-use and redistribution terms remain unresolved.
temporal_refresh: Many filed-document images from January 1, 1997 onward are available, excluding unaccepted or withdrawn submissions. This image availability is not a database history or refresh contract.

citations.evidence: Current rule distinguishes existing database records from discretionary creation of abstracts/summaries and permits reasonable fees.
Public examination and personal-data handling described.
Current document product, price and historical-image limits; not a bulk feed.
Principal-office and registered-office updates are separate filings.
Website use, fair-use and attribution scope.

strongest_next_action: First establish whether an existing recurring entity-only extract is offered, as distinct from a discretionary custom abstract. Obtain its schema, scope, ID/status/address definitions, refresh and delivery terms, price and derived-use scope. This assessment authorizes no contact, production request or portal query.
